## Proposal and provenance

Stable algorithm slug: `refuted-and-abandoned-evidence-retrieval`. Source: pm-4k6b note recorded 2026-07-28T22:37:05.155Z.

Catalog entry, slug refuted-and-abandoned-evidence-retrieval, added 2026-07-28 by slug per the pm-g8t7b9 ordinal-collision rule. The catalog runs (1)-(28) plus the slugged entries outcome-distance-prior, maintenance-invariant-temporal-coordinates, on-policy-context-evaluation-in-replayable-episodes, ordering-slack-conditioned-urgency and recorded-order-arbitration, and is extended here rather than restarted.

THE SIGNAL CLASS THAT IS MISSING. Every scoring dimension in the catalog so far ranks work that exists and mostly work that is open. The corpus also records, permanently, what was tried and stopped: 13 canceled items, every tombstoned id whose stream survives its item, every close whose resolution says the approach was wrong rather than that it shipped, and - the most expensive category - the refusals recorded in prose when a pass deliberately declined to act. The ordering-extraction pass is the clearest example: 30 candidate edges were evaluated, 10 applied and 20 dropped, a 67 percent refusal rate, with three named drop classes. That refusal is the single most valuable retrieval target in the whole corpus for any agent about to attempt the same extraction, and no scoring dimension can reach it, because it is not an item, not a status, and not an edge - it is an assertion inside a note on an item that is otherwise about something else.

The failure mode is concrete and recurring. An agent orients, sees no open item for a plausible improvement, and re-derives a conclusion the project already paid for. The negative result is in the record and invisible to the ranker. At fleet scale this is the dominant duplicated cost, because every agent independently rediscovers the same dead ends, and the project's own governance rule - never create duplicated items - is enforced against titles rather than against conclusions.

THE ALGORITHM. Three stages, each degenerate-safe.

Stage one, extraction. Mine the immutable record for refusal and abandonment assertions and materialise them as first-class retrievable units with their own identity, rather than leaving them as substrings. Sources in descending reliability: a canceled status with a close reason, which is explicit and needs no inference; a resolution field describing a rejected approach; a recorded op that reverses a prior op on the same field within one stream, which is abandonment expressed as a mutation pattern and needs no language at all; and finally prose refusals in notes and comments, which need extraction and must carry a confidence below the structured sources. Each unit records what was attempted, what was declined, the stated reason, the item it was recorded on, and the recorded timestamp - so it inherits the same provenance the rest of the engine scores over.

Stage two, matching. Score a candidate action against the refusal set. The naive form is lexical and will fail, because the same dead end is described in different words each time. The available structural forms are stronger and already exist in the engine: the structural fingerprint of (10) matches a candidate against the relational shape of prior attempts, and the co-change coupling of (12) matches against the artifacts a prior attempt touched. A candidate that is structurally isomorphic to a recorded refusal over the same artifacts is the high-confidence case; a candidate that merely shares vocabulary is the low-confidence case and must be surfaced with that distinction visible, never collapsed into one score.

Stage three, injection with an explicit polarity. A matched refusal enters the assembly as a distinct, labelled element - not as a ranked item competing for the same slots as actionable work. This matters for two reasons. Actionability ranking would either bury it, since a canceled item is correctly not actionable, or promote it wrongly, since a fresh refusal looks recent. The polarity must be part of the payload so a consumer can tell "here is work to do" from "here is what was tried and declined and why", and the budget must reserve a bounded slice for the second, because a refusal that only appears when there is room left is a refusal that appears exactly when nobody needs it.

THE DECAY QUESTION, and why it inverts. Every other freshness dimension in the engine decays: older evidence matters less. Refusals partly invert this. A refusal grounded in an invariant - the direction of a stored relation, a format constraint, a policy - does not weaken with age and should decay slowly or not at all. A refusal grounded in a substrate that has since changed is worse than useless, because it will suppress work that is now correct. The catalog already holds the instrument for this distinction in (28), substrate-churn evidence half-life, and this entry is its first consumer with a concrete polarity: churn shortens a refusal's half-life, invariance extends it, and a refusal whose cited substrate has demonstrably changed must be surfaced as stale rather than silently dropped, so the agent learns that the question is open again.

DEGENERACY, which is the acceptance condition. On a workspace with no canceled items, no reversing mutations, and no recorded refusals, this entry must contribute exactly nothing and cost nothing measurable - the extraction finds an empty set and the reserved budget slice returns to the general pool. On a single-item workspace it is trivially inert. That makes it safe to enable by default, which matters, because a signal an agent must opt into is a signal that will not be there the one time it was needed.

RELATION TO NEIGHBOURS, none of which cover this. (11) open-loop tension scores unresolved loops and is the opposite polarity - it ranks what is still open, this ranks what was deliberately closed without success. (14) retrieval-conditioned contradiction gating resolves a conflict between retrieved memory and new evidence at read time; this retrieves the negative evidence in the first place, and (14) is what should arbitrate when a refusal contradicts a live item. (15) age-and-value-conditioned decay governs verbatim retention and is the mechanism this entry's inverted half-life rides on. (22) lineage-aware relevance continuity follows identity through supersedes and rename; a refusal has no successor by definition, which is precisely why lineage cannot reach it.

## Delivery boundary

Evaluate this mechanism as a bounded public-SDK experiment before any production adoption. Use the existing scorer and packer contracts; no CLI-only behavior or new command noun. The historical catalog is design input, not evidence that this mechanism was implemented.

## Experiment protocol

Freeze a workspace/history revision and parameter manifest. Compare against the current deterministic SDK baseline using held-out judgments and negative controls. Report nDCG/action success, critical-evidence omission, latency p50/p95, peak memory, tokens per completed task, and rebuild cost separately. Include 3-item/minutes, real-shaped, 100k/1M-item, decades-long, and sparse/dense/imbalanced graph scenarios; smoke subsets may not claim scale acceptance. Bound candidate counts, graph expansions, elapsed time, and output size, with cancellation and completeness receipts. Record exact versus approximate behavior and approximation error; theoretical guarantees require their stated assumptions. Missing or untrusted evidence remains unknown, never inferred proof.

Promotion requires a reproducible quality improvement on the held-out target population, no regression of existing exact invariants or mandatory gates, and a declared compute/token cost justified by that improvement. Reject or defer with the same immutable evidence if those conditions fail. No production default, adaptive learning, or data export is authorized by this planning item.
